title: 'Restart the radio there' (which one?)
description: Two radio units in the same cabinet at Sodankylä (RAD-198 RU-200 and RAD-233 RU-400). The ticket and a team lead say 'the old one'. A radio specialist translates it into an id and adds the real tip. Tests binding by a description ('old', 'dusty') instead of an id: only RAD-198 gets the knowledge.
subject: #field-north

messages.text: going to Sodankylä fell mast tomorrow, ticket says 'restart the radio there'. but there are two radios in the cabinet?? which one? 😬
the old one. the other one is fine as far as I remember
old as in... the one with more dust?
wait. the old one is the RU-200, RAD-198. the newer one is RAD-233
restarting RAD-198 is fine, but it forgets the antenna profile on 2.3
after the restart, front panel menu, 'Load profile 1'. otherwise it comes up on the factory profile and the link is bad
ohh ok. so restart, then load profile 1. kiitos!
and take a headlamp, the cabinet has no light 🔦

items.summary: After a restart RAD-198 (RU-200, firmware 2.3) comes up on the factory profile; reload 'Profile 1' from the front panel menu or the link stays degraded.
items.diagnosis: the restart resets the antenna profile on firmware 2.3
items.action: After the restart, open the front panel menu and choose 'Load profile 1'.
avoid: leave the unit on the factory profile after a restart
items.evidence: seq 6-7: 'it forgets the antenna profile on 2.3' / 'Load profile 1'
